authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Previously reviewed comparative evidence: CDIAL 2871 karpaṭa lists Prakrit kappaḍa, Punjabi kappṛā, Marwari kapṛo, Gujarati kāpaṛ and Marathi kāpaḍ “cloth”. It explicitly marks several Nepali/Bihari/Awadhi kapṛā forms as Hindi loans and questions short-vowel Gujarati borrowing; these are held. The addenda also question the older word’s formation. Updated disposition under the user’s explicit cross-Indo-Aryan policy: link this supported etymon despite unresolved inheritance versus intra-Indo-Aryan borrowing. The reflex edge records etymological family affiliation provisionally; it does not establish uninterrupted inheritance or an immediate donor. Prior hold: CDIAL 2871 labels several eastern kapṛā forms Hindi loans; identify a supported immediate donor before saving.
